This temporary page checks client-side components that remain interactive after Quarto output is
placed inside the Quartz page frame. See [Computational Features](examples/computational-features.qmd) for Python tables and figures,
and [Markdown Features](examples/markdown-features.md) for the plain Markdown boundary.

## Observable JS

Python serialises data into the page with `ojs_define`. Observable filters and redraws it reactively
in the browser.

```{python}
#| label: interactive-data
#| echo: false
sample_sizes = [10, 20, 50, 100, 200, 500, 1000]
errors = [0.25, 0.16, 0.09, 0.06, 0.04, 0.025, 0.018]
series = [{"n": n, "error": error} for n, error in zip(sample_sizes, errors)]
ojs_define(series=series)
```

```{ojs}
//| label: ojs-input
viewof cutoff = Inputs.range([10, 1000], { value: 1000, step: 10, label: "max samples" })
```

```{ojs}
//| label: ojs-derived
filtered = series.filter((row) => row.n <= cutoff)
```

```{ojs}
//| label: ojs-readout
md`Showing **${filtered.length}** of **${series.length}** points, up to n = **${cutoff}**.`
```

```{ojs}
//| label: ojs-palette
//| echo: false
seriesColor = (n) => getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue(`--qmd-chart-series-${n}`).trim()
```

```{ojs}
//| label: ojs-plot
Plot.plot({
  marks: [
    Plot.line(filtered, { x: "n", y: "error", stroke: seriesColor(1) }),
    Plot.dot(filtered, { x: "n", y: "error", fill: seriesColor(1) })
  ],
  x: { type: "log", label: "samples" },
  y: { type: "log", label: "absolute error" },
  height: 300
})
```

```{ojs}
//| label: ojs-table
Inputs.table(filtered)
```

## Browser-only Jupyter widgets

Published widgets have no Python kernel behind them. `jslink` keeps this slider, progress bar, and
readout connected entirely in the browser.

```{python}
#| label: linked-widgets
import ipywidgets as widgets

slider = widgets.IntSlider(
    value=40, min=0, max=100, step=1, description="samples:", continuous_update=True
)
progress = widgets.IntProgress(value=40, min=0, max=100, description="coverage:")
readout = widgets.IntText(value=40, description="value:")

widgets.jslink((slider, "value"), (progress, "value"))
widgets.jslink((slider, "value"), (readout, "value"))
widgets.VBox([slider, progress, readout])
```

Tabs exercise widget layout handling:

```{python}
#| label: tabbed-widgets
tabs = widgets.Tab(
    children=[
        widgets.HTML("<p>Independent samples converge at a predictable rate.</p>"),
        widgets.HTML("<p>Correlated draws reduce the effective sample size.</p>"),
    ]
)
tabs.set_title(0, "Independent")
tabs.set_title(1, "Correlated")
tabs
```

Finally, `ipyleaflet` checks loading a third-party widget bundle:

```{python}
#| label: leaflet-map
from ipyleaflet import Map, Marker

site_map = Map(center=(43.6532, -79.3832), zoom=9)
site_map.add(Marker(location=(43.6532, -79.3832)))
site_map
```
